name: ashby_list_candidates
description: Search candidates in your ATS. Returns names, emails, and application metadata. Use ashby_get_candidate with ID for full profile details.

name: ashby_get_candidate

description: Search open positions. Filter by status (open, closed, draft, archived). Returns job title, department, and posting details.
